capabilities: Outline chapters and scene beats in a sidebar with point of view, filters, and a board
Track word goals, sprints, and workflow stages with automatic snapshots
Underline echoes, adverbs, crutch words, and long sentences with a revision lens
Manage a shared universe of characters, places, objects, and events across works
Export manuscripts to Markdown, DOCX, EPUB, or screenplay PDF
extras: Full per-feature guides are hosted outside the README in English and Brazilian Portuguese; the plugin claims no network access, no AI, and no telemetry, and requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. It ships localized in English and Brazilian Portuguese and can also be installed via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structures for fiction work such as scene-beat outlines, writing goals, revision aids, or manuscript export to DOCX and EPUB.

relations.evidence: Escrita is inspired by NEO by Hugh Howey (MIT License).

summary: Fiction-writing toolkit that adds chapter outlines with scene beats, word goals, a revision lens, a shared story world, and manuscript export.
